sunfields.name: The Sunfields
sunfields.text: A wide harshly sunlit frontier of hard earth, glassed patches, exposed metal ribs and settlements separated more by custom than by clean borders. Communities are socially distinct and often temporary; travelers carry breadth while locals carry depth. Sunforges may sit beside roads, under homes or outside town as ordinary facts nobody agrees how to interpret.

last-drop.name: The Last Drop Saloon
last-drop.text: Dusty frontier saloon and settlement social center with splintered boards, a dark rear wall, patched bar, hard white daylight at the doors and a back lot used for public punishment as readily as cargo. Marcus's authority depends on reputation, audience and everyone accepting his version of what happened. A half-buried Sunforge shape nearby is treated as ordinary shade rather than sacred machinery.

cinder-basin.name: Cinder Basin / Los Lagartos Camp
cinder-basin.text: White alkali dust, fractured basalt and patched shade structures around the exposed ribs of a half-buried Sunforge. Los Lagartos is an itinerant brotherhood and extended traveling community, not a military checkpoint. Meals, kinship, jokes, inherited obligations and a succession dispute organize the space more than terrain or machinery.

mirage-club.name: The Mirage Club
mirage-club.text: Subterranean frontier cabaret and refuge of oxidized copper, dark wood, old mirrors, small performance spaces and private back rooms. Its central social rule is NO NAMES BELOW: patrons may leave outside identities at the stairs. Isabelle's decision to call Kael 'Merrit' therefore breaks a community norm before it becomes a personal confrontation.

relay-station.name: Relay Settlement
relay-station.text: A worn frontier settlement gathered beneath an old relay tower, used as neutral ground by travelers, families and people waiting to meet someone. Message boards, communal tables, sleeping corners and side rooms matter more than the surviving equipment. The relay infrastructure is background texture, not a technical problem to solve.

bellweather.name: Bellweather
bellweather.text: A close family settlement arranged around shaded courtyards, long meal tables and houses shared across generations. Wakes are communal and unresolved promises to the dead are spoken aloud. The local conflict is carried by kinship, memory and obligation rather than machinery.

rowan-hold.name: Rowan Hold
rowan-hold.text: A settled agricultural community of shade trees, low stone houses and a shared family record room. An exposed black Sunforge arc crosses the common yard and is used as ordinary seating. The community is loving, interdependent and capable of turning competence into obligation without intending cruelty.

long-mile.name: The Long Mile
long-mile.text: An open pale road through white ground, low ridges and dry washes with long sight lines and very few structures. Distance is genuinely hard to judge here, which preserves ordinary explanations for the Rider until repeated landmarks make the spatial behavior difficult to dismiss.

saint-oren.name: Saint Oren's
saint-oren.text: A settled community built directly around a massive exposed black ribbed structure most travelers would call a Sunforge. Locals use it for shade, tables and ordinary daily life. The place is socially calm enough to let the travelers experience several days in which Kael is simply Kael.

rookery.name: The Rookery
rookery.text: A dense crossroads settlement of boarding rooms, family workshops, courtyards and market tables. Distinct travelers and locals accumulate here for ordinary reasons that outsiders cannot see at a glance. Several dark structures have different local histories even though travelers may group them all under the word Sunforge.

glasshouse.name: Glasshouse
glasshouse.text: A lived-in settlement of shaded courtyards and old translucent panels where Jessa once stayed for several months. It is neither a secret origin point nor a mystery site; its dramatic value is that people here know Jessa correctly and remember an ordinary life she had before the current group.

hushwater.name: Hushwater
hushwater.text: A modest settlement of shaded houses and a communal dining court. No obvious Sunforge dominates the center. Promises and household records carry long memories here, allowing an expectation about Darrow Keene to be dated to before Veyra and Samuel could have planted it.
